Since the universe is expanding, there must be some realm beyond what is currently called the material universe, where there is more energy than there is in the material. And this energy must then somehow find a way into the material universe to drive the expansion. This is what happens in your sun, and in all of the other suns throughout the universe. 
There is an influx of energy that comes through the many suns, which could be called a form of white hole, even though there is also the concept of white holes. You have certain centers in the universe, where energy in a form of light enters the material realm.

text: Great quick breakdown. The key nuance everyone misses is Astra isn't here for everyone yet it's for selected access only. The leap is real and the benchmarks are impressive but the most telling detail is how carefully they're rolling it out. Limited release heavy review staggered access. That says what they won't say openly this model is powerful enough that even its builders are nervous to release it widely. Manav Golecha explains this perfectly too when the creators themselves pause and limit their own launch that isn't marketing that is a warning. His fuller perspective is well worth checking out.
